text:
Chloe: Tiny celebration alert — it's @Omar's micro-birthday (no cake required, just vibes) :partying_face:
Omar: I demand confetti and one bad dad joke. Deliver or prepare to be roasted. :gavel:
Priya: Confetti machine in storage 3? I can run it for 10s. Worth the cleanup. :sparkles:
OncallBot: Reminder: oncall rotation change at 6pm. @Diego you're up. Please ack in #eng-oncall. :bell:
Diego: Acked. Also shoutout to @Maya for triaging yesterday's paged-out alert at 2am. Lifesaver. :heart:
Maya: Thanks! I found the bug was a missing null check and an overcaffeinated alarm. :coffee:
Chloe: Micro-poll: confetti duration? React :one: 3s, :two: 7s, :three: 10s (we do not discuss cleanup).
Priya: :three: (full spectacle)
Omar: :two: keep my desk plants safe pls. They don't like glitter. :seedling:
Diego: Also one-liner contest: winner gets an extra sticker. Drop your best cringe dad-joke.
Maya: "Why did the CPU bring a blanket? Because it needed to stay warm during idle cycles." :cpu:
Priya: "I told my coffee it was an overachiever. It asked for a raise." :money_mouth_face:
Omar: "I would tell you a UDP joke, but you might not get it." :nerd_face:
Chloe: Vote for the best one-liner with reactions. I'll tally before confetti.
OncallBot: FYI: confetti uses the lounge only. Facilities requests a 15-minute post-clean. :wrench:
Diego: Shoutout to @Maya again and to Facilities for lending the vacuum. Small wins are huge today. :tada:
Maya: No cake, but cookies in the kitchen labeled "Omar - help yourself". Please don't take them all. :cookie:
Omar: Appreciated. Also I accept dad jokes as gifts. Meeting adjourned to cookie table. :wave:
